name: year
observations: Partition column. Derived from the sitting date

name: date
description: Date on which the chamber sat

name: chamber
observations: Two values: House of Representatives, Senate. One row per chamber per sitting day

name: parliament_number
description: Ordinal number of the Parliament in session
observations: Stored as STRING because it labels a Parliament rather than measuring a quantity

name: session_number
description: Ordinal number of the session within the Parliament

name: period_number
description: Ordinal number of the sitting period within the session

name: is_proof
description: Whether the transcript is a proof version rather than the official record
observations: Boolean stored as a 0/1 code. Proof transcripts are published on the sitting day and may be revised before the official version appears

name: speech_count
description: Number of utterances recorded for the chamber on the day
observations: Derived by counting rows in the speech table for this chamber and date

name: page_count
description: Number of printed Hansard pages recorded in the transcript header
observations: Taken from the source header. Reported as 0 in recent transcripts, which are not paginated the same way

name: source_url
description: URL the transcript was retrieved from
observations: Points at the ParlInfo download path, or at the GLAM Workbench mirror for sitting days ParlInfo no longer serves
